log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file for the naming service.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the log file before rotation (0 = no limit).

log_max_backup_index.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to keep (before oldest is deleted).

name_service_port.description: TCP port on which the Naming Service listens. Standard CORBA port 2809 is recommended.

stdout.description: If true, log output is also written to standard output (useful for containerized deployments).

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = none, 10 = very verbose). Higher values increase log verbosity.

ior_file.description: Absolute path to the default IOR (Inter-ORB Reference) file used by clients to locate the Naming Service.

ior_files.description: List of additional IOR files (e.g., for multi-homed or HA setups). Each entry defines a purpose and path.

description.description: Short description of the IOR file purpose (e.g., 'backup', 'public interface').

path.description: Absolute path to the IOR file.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections (0 = unlimited). Set a limit to protect against resource exhaustion.

persistent_state.description: If true, the naming context is persisted to disk so it survives restarts.

persistent_state_file.description: Absolute path to the file where persistent naming context data is stored (only used if persistent_state=true).

shutdown_delay.description: Seconds to wait after receiving SIGTERM before terminating (allows graceful drain of pending requests).

use_ssl.description: If true, SSL/TLS is enabled for secure Naming Service communication.

ssl_cert_file.description: Absolute path to the X.509 certificate file (PEM format) for SSL.

ssl_key_file.description: Absolute path to the private key file (PEM format) for SSL.

host.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or hostname the Naming Service binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::').

ipv6.description: If true, enable IPv6 support (required if binding to an IPv6 address).
